added_lines: Since 1831, Generali has empowered the lives and dreams of millions of People

Today, more than 87,000 colleagues across over 50 countries contribute to a global insurance and asset management Group built on long-term vision, international scale, and a strong People-centred Culture.
At Generali, People are at the heart of how we create value and contribute to the future of our business. Guided by our
, we build meaningful relationships with over 71 million customers and engage with colleagues and the communities we serve, while striving for Excellence in everything we do.

Working at Generali means joining an International Group where People can grow, make an impact, and build long-term careers. Flexible hybrid work, a strong commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, and continuous learning and development opportunities support an environment where individuals can thrive and shape their professional journey.
